problem.name: fixture_valid
problem.reference:
theorem fixture_valid (n : Nat) : n + 0 = n := by
  have h : n + 0 = n := Nat.add_zero n
  exact h

problem.name: fixture_auto
problem.reference: theorem fixture_auto (P : Prop) (h : P) : P := by exact h

problem.name: fixture_recursive
problem.statement: theorem fixture_recursive : ∃ f : Nat → Nat, ∀ n, f n = n + 17
problem.reference:
theorem fixture_recursive : ∃ f : Nat → Nat, ∀ n, f n = n + 17 := by
  have h : ∀ n : Nat, (fun x => x + 17) n = n + 17 := by
    intro n
    rfl
  exact ⟨fun x => x + 17, h⟩
